description: The top 12 identities (fewer on a narrow panel, down to 8) by signal volume, one tile per identity, in a block per kind; the rest of each kind is folded into one grey "+N more" tile. Area grows with the square root of event volume and every tile gets a minimum share so its name stays readable; colour is accumulated severity on a square-root scale. Grouped on raw fields first and resolved afterwards, so an identity whose events disagree about its kind is still one tile, in its most specific block.

url.query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE (attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action IS NULL OR NOT (attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action IN ("cluster:monitor/main", "elastic.maintenance") OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/search*" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/msearch*" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/scroll*" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/*point_in_time" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action == "indices:data/read/open_reader_context" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/esql*" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:admin/esql/*" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/field_caps*" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/async_search/*" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:admin/resolve/*" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action == "indices:admin/shards/search_shards")) AND (attributes.event.action IS NULL OR NOT (attributes.event.action IN ("authentication_success","connection_granted") OR attributes.event.action IN ("saved_object_open_point_in_time","saved_object_close_point_in_time","space_get","space_find") OR (attributes.event.action == "http_request" AND attributes.url.original IS NOT NULL AND attributes.url.original RLIKE "https?://[^/]+(/s/[^/]+)?/(internal/|api/content_management/rpc/(get|search|mget|bulkGet)).*") OR (attributes.event.action IN ("saved_object_get","saved_object_resolve","saved_object_find") AND attributes.kibana.saved_object.id IS NOT NULL AND attributes.kibana.saved_object.id LIKE "cloud-audit-*"))) | STATS n = COUNT(*) BY attributes.api_key.name, attributes.user.email, attributes.user.name, attributes.user.domain, attributes.event.action, scc = attributes.elasticsearch.audit.security_config_change IS NOT NULL, attributes.event.outcome, resource.attributes.service.name, et = MV_CONCAT(attributes.event.type, ",") | EVAL attributes.event.type = SPLIT(et, ","), attributes.elasticsearch.audit.security_config_change = CASE(scc, "present") | EVAL risk = CASE(attributes.event.action == "invalidate_apikeys", 45, attributes.event.action == "anonymous_access_denied", 35, attributes.elasticsearch.audit.security_config_change IS NOT NULL, 50, attributes.event.outcome == "failure", 40, (resource.attributes.service.name == "serverless-kibana" AND ((attributes.event.type IN ("change","creation","deletion") AND (attributes.event.action IS NULL OR NOT (attributes.event.action IN ("saved_object_open_point_in_time","saved_object_close_point_in_time")))) OR attributes.event.action IN ("rule_run_soon","secret_create"))) AND attributes.event.action IN ("workflow_run","workflow_test","workflow_execution_cancel"), 10, (resource.attributes.service.name == "serverless-kibana" AND ((attributes.event.type IN ("change","creation","deletion") AND (attributes.event.action IS NULL OR NOT (attributes.event.action IN ("saved_object_open_point_in_time","saved_object_close_point_in_time")))) OR attributes.event.action IN ("rule_run_soon","secret_create"))) AND (attributes.event.type == "deletion" OR attributes.event.action == "rule_disable"), 30, (resource.attributes.service.name == "serverless-kibana" AND ((attributes.event.type IN ("change","creation","deletion") AND (attributes.event.action IS NULL OR NOT (attributes.event.action IN ("saved_object_open_point_in_time","saved_object_close_point_in_time")))) OR attributes.event.action IN ("rule_run_soon","secret_create"))), 25, 0) | STATS events = SUM(n), severity = SUM(risk * n), scoring = SUM(CASE(risk > 0, n, 0)) BY attributes.api_key.name, attributes.user.email, attributes.user.name, attributes.user.domain | EVAL actor = CASE(attributes.api_key.name IS NOT NULL, attributes.api_key.name, COALESCE(attributes.user.email, attributes.user.name, "<anonymous>")), kind_rank = CASE(attributes.api_key.name IS NOT NULL, 4, attributes.user.email IS NOT NULL, 3, attributes.user.domain == "_cloud_api_key", 2, 1), owner = CASE(attributes.api_key.name IS NOT NULL, COALESCE(attributes.user.email, attributes.user.name), null) | STATS events = SUM(events), severity = SUM(severity), scoring = SUM(scoring), kind_rank = MAX(kind_rank), owner = MAX(owner) BY actor | EVAL actor_kind = CASE(kind_rank == 4, "named API key", kind_rank == 3, "person", kind_rank == 2, "cloud API key", "unattributed") | SORT events DESC | LIMIT 500 | KEEP actor, actor_kind, owner, events, severity, scoring
